div.head: III Atr 16
div.ab: ⁊ þa myneteras þe inne wuda wyrceð oððe elles hwær, þæt þa bion heora feores scyldig, buton se cyning heom arian wille.
⁊ þa myneteras þe inne wuda wyrceð oððe elles hwær, þæt þa bion heora feores scyldig, buton se cyning heom arian wille.
And moneyers who work in a wood or elsewhere shall forfeit their lives, unless the king is willing to pardon them.
And those moneyers who work in the wood or elsewhere are to forfeit their lives, unless the king wishes to spare them.
Und die Münzer, die im Walde oder sonstwo [verstohlen] arbeiten, dass die [des Verlustes] ihres Lebens schuldig seien; es sei denn, der König will sie schonen.
And the moneyers who work in a wood or anywhere else [in secret], that they be liable [to lose] their lives, unless the king is willing to spare them.
div.note: Not in Quadripartitus (so K is empty). Liebermann would expect this sentence after 8; it stands at a better place in IV Atr 5.4, so is perhaps not original here. A word like ‘similibus’ should be supplied after ‘elles hwær’ (IV Atr 5.4). In H, the ‘Exorcismus aque’ (Ordal, Schmid's App. XVII) follows.
